cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to APRS-IS server {host}.

yaml_import_cannot_connect.description:
Importing the APRS device tracker configuration for {callsign} failed because Home Assistant could not connect to the APRS-IS server {host}.

Check that the server is reachable, then restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the APRS `device_tracker` configuration from your configuration.yaml file and set up the APRS integration in the UI.
yaml_import_cannot_connect.title: The APRS YAML configuration could not be imported

yaml_import_invalid_auth.description:
Importing the APRS device tracker configuration for {callsign} failed because the APRS-IS server refused its passcode.

Fix or remove the `password` in the APRS `device_tracker` configuration in your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant, or remove that configuration and set up the APRS integration in the UI.
yaml_import_invalid_auth.title: [%key:component::aprs::issues::yaml_import_cannot_connect::title%]

yaml_import_invalid_callsign.description:
Importing the APRS device tracker configuration for {callsign} failed because its `username` is not a valid callsign. It must be a callsign, optionally with an SSID, such as N0CALL-13.

Fix the `username` in the APRS `device_tracker` configuration in your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant, or remove that configuration and set up the APRS integration in the UI.
yaml_import_invalid_callsign.title: [%key:component::aprs::issues::yaml_import_cannot_connect::title%]

yaml_import_invalid_callsigns.description:
Importing the APRS device tracker configuration for {callsign} failed because its `callsigns` are not valid. Each must be a callsign, optionally with an SSID or ending in * for every SSID.

Fix the `callsigns` in the APRS `device_tracker` configuration in your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant, or remove that configuration and set up the APRS integration in the UI.
yaml_import_invalid_callsigns.title: [%key:component::aprs::issues::yaml_import_cannot_connect::title%]

yaml_import_unknown.description:
Importing the APRS device tracker configuration for {callsign} failed with an unexpected error; check the logs for details.

Restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the APRS `device_tracker` configuration from your configuration.yaml file and set up the APRS integration in the UI.
yaml_import_unknown.title: [%key:component::aprs::issues::yaml_import_cannot_connect::title%]
